title: The AI giants just broke with OpenAI and Anthropic on open weights

content_html:
The AI industry just picked a side, in public. On Friday, 25 companies and groups published an open letter, “Open Weights and American AI Leadership”, urging Washington not to crack down on open-weight AI, Business Insider reported.

The names are heavy: Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta, Mistral, Palantir, IBM, Andreessen Horowitz, Hugging Face, Mozilla and the Linux Foundation. Jensen Huang fronted it with his first-ever post on X, which drew more than 11 million views.

“For my first post, I’m sharing a letter Nvidia signed on why open models matter,” the Nvidia chief wrote. “The world needs both frontier closed models and frontier open models.”

The letter reaches back to the 1980s, casting open weights as the heir to the open-source software that now “supports most of the internet”. America’s AI lead, it argues, “will be judged not by one frontier AI model, but by whether the United States builds a strong, open ecosystem”.

Who didn’t sign

The absences say as much as the signatures. OpenAI, Anthropic and Google did not sign. They are the closed-model leaders.

Each would gain if Washington blocked Chinese open-model makers like Moonshot. Its Kimi K3 is the world’s most powerful open-weight model. The letter is, in effect, the rest of the industry lining up against them. It landed a day after nearly 200 startups made the same plea to the White House.

The closed camp did not fight it. Altman said he was “glad to see” the support. Microsoft’s Satya Nadella backed the message the same day, CNBC reported.

Even Musk, whose SpaceX did not sign, quote-tweeted Huang: “This has my full support. Jensen is right.”

Turning the safety argument around

The letter’s boldest move is to aim the safety case at the closed labs. Relying only on closed models “is not inherently safe”, it says, because they “can be breached, misused, or fail in ways that outsiders cannot detect”. Concentrating AI behind a few closed models creates “single points of failure”.

Openness, by contrast, “may be one of the most important paths to AI safety”. That is a direct answer to OpenAI and Anthropic, who have made security the heart of their case for restricting Chinese open models.

The China problem

The timing is not subtle.

This week the White House’s Michael Kratsios accused Moonshot of building Kimi K3 by distilling Anthropic’s Fable 5. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent floated sanctions for distillation he likened to theft.

The letter calls distillation “a widely used technique”, but does not wave off every abuse. Policymakers should not “conflate legitimate model-development techniques with misappropriation”, it says, and unlawful extraction deserves “targeted” rules “rather than sweeping restrictions”.

There is self-interest here, and an awkward truth. Nvidia sells chips to everyone. Meta, Mistral and Hugging Face build open models. All of them gain if open AI spreads. And the US has fallen behind on the very thing the letter champions, as China now leads a field America once defined.

The signatories want Washington to keep “the frontier plural” and avoid “premature restrictions” that “stifle competition or drive innovation overseas”. Whether America can still win a race it is currently losing is the question the letter cannot answer.

content_html_zh:
人工智能行业刚刚在公开场合选择了立场。 据《商业内幕》报道，周五，25 家公司和团体发表了一封公开信，题为“开放权重和美国人工智能领导力”，敦促华盛顿不要打击开放权重人工智能。

这些名字很重：Nvidia、微软、Meta、Mistral、Palantir、IBM、Andreessen Horowitz、Hugging Face、Mozilla 和 Linux 基金会。 黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 在 X 上发布了他的第一篇帖子，吸引了超过 1100 万次浏览。

“在我的第一篇文章中，我分享了一封 Nvidia 签署的信，解释为什么开放模型很重要，”Nvidia 首席执行官写道。 “世界既需要边境封闭模式，也需要边境开放模式。”

这封信的时间可以追溯到 20 世纪 80 年代，将开放权重视为现在“支持大部分互联网”的开源软件的继承人。 报告认为，美国的人工智能领先地位“将不是根据一种前沿人工智能模型来判断，而是根据美国是否建立了一个强大、开放的生态系统”。

谁没签名

缺席和签名一样说明了一切。 OpenAI、Anthropic 和谷歌没有签署。 他们是封闭型领导者。

如果华盛顿阻止像Moonshot这样的中国开放模式制造商，双方都会受益。 其 Kimi K3 是世界上最强大的开放式重量模型。 实际上，这封信是业界其他人联合起来反对他们的。 一天前，近 200 家初创公司向白宫提出了同样的请求。

封闭营并没有与之抗争。 奥尔特曼表示，他“很高兴看到”这些支持。 据 CNBC 报道，微软的萨蒂亚·纳德拉 (Satya Nadella) 同一天也支持了这一消息。

就连马斯克（其 SpaceX 并未签字）也引用了黄的推文：“我全力支持。 詹森是对的。”

扭转安全争论

这封信中最大胆的举措是将安全案例瞄准封闭实验室。 报告称，仅依赖封闭模型“本质上并不安全”，因为它们“可能会被破坏、滥用或以外界无法察觉的方式失败”。 将人工智能集中在几个封闭模型后面会产生“单点故障”。

相比之下，开放“可能是实现人工智能安全的最重要途径之一”。 这是对 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的直接回应，他们将安全作为限制中国开放模式的核心。

中国问题

时机并不微妙。

本周，白宫的 Michael Kratsios 指责 Moonshot 通过提炼 Anthropic 的《神鬼寓言 5》来打造 Kimi K3。 财政部长斯科特·贝森特(Scott Bessent)对他将蒸馏视为盗窃的行为提出了制裁。

这封信称蒸馏是“一种广泛使用的技术”，但并没有消除所有滥用行为。 报告称，政策制定者不应“将合法的模型开发技术与盗用混为一谈”，非法开采应该受到“有针对性的”规则“而不是全面的限制”。

这里存在着自身利益，以及一个尴尬的事实。 英伟达向所有人出售芯片。 Meta、Mistral 和 Hugging Face 构建开放模型。 如果开放人工智能得以传播，所有这些人都会受益。 美国在这封信所倡导的事情上已经落后了，而中国现在在美国曾经定义的领域处于领先地位。

签署方希望华盛顿保持“前沿多元化”，并避免“扼杀竞争或推动海外创新”的“过早限制”。 美国是否还能赢得一场目前正在输掉的比赛，这是这封信无法回答的问题。
